description: One browse + one JSON catalog for Warlords weapon skills. Drafts worker is not the catalog.

objectstoreWorker.role: Cloudflare Worker. /v1 = R2+D1 asset CRUD. /api/v1/*.json MUST proxy info (no R2 catalog cache). Not the browse HTML. Not Vercel.

pagesMirror.role: Git Pages mirror of JSON. Fallback only.

githubPages.role: Legacy Pages mirror. Do not treat as SSOT.

draftsDo.role: Durable Object drafts / promote for Casting production overrides. NOT the catalog browse. NOT master-weaponSkills.

iconLaw: Each skill id maps to one PNG from icon-path-index.json (skills_rpg / abilities / skills/class / spells). Same skill id (and same skill name) reuses that PNG on every weapon that offers it. Never a sprite sheet. Never a weapon-item PNG for a skill.
